import csv
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUTPUT = 'mesh/evidence/audit.json'
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
def command(args):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'})
    return {'command': args, 'exit_code': p.returncode, 'stdout': p.stdout, 'stderr': p.stderr}
def inventory():
    files = {}
    issues = []
    for base, dirs, names in os.walk(ROOT, followlinks=False):
        dirs.sort()
        if Path(base) == ROOT and '.git' in dirs:
            dirs.remove('.git')
        for name in sorted(names):
            p = Path(base) / name
            rel = p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
            if rel in ('.git', OUTPUT):
                continue
            if p.is_symlink():
                issues.append({'path': rel, 'category': 'symlink_requires_target_review'})
                files[rel] = os.readlink(p).encode()
            else:
                try:
                    files[rel] = p.read_bytes()
                except OSError:
                    issues.append({'path': rel, 'category': 'unreadable_current_file'})
        for name in dirs[:]:
            p = Path(base) / name
            if p.is_symlink():
                rel = p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                files[rel] = os.readlink(p).encode()
                issues.append({'path': rel, 'category': 'symlink_requires_target_review'})
                dirs.remove(name)
    return files, issues

# Findings store locations and categories only, never matched credential bytes.
SECRET_PATTERNS = [
    ('private_key', re.compile(r'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----')),
    ('aws_access_key', re.compile(r'\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b')),
    ('github_token', re.compile(r'\b(?:gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{40,})\b')),
    ('assigned_credential', re.compile(r'''(?im)^\s*["']?(?:api_key|access_token|secret_key|password)["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']([^\s"']{12,})["']''')),
]
def scan(files):
    findings = []
    for name, data in sorted(files.items()):
        text = data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
        for category, pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                findings.append({'path': name, 'line': text.count('\n', 0, match.start()) + 1, 'category': category})
        for match in re.finditer(r'(?<![\d.])(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}(?![\d.])', text):
            try:
                addr = ipaddress.ip_address(match.group())
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if addr.is_private and not addr.is_loopback and not addr.is_unspecified:
                findings.append({'path': name, 'line': text.count('\n', 0, match.start()) + 1, 'category': 'private_address_requires_review'})
    return findings

def receipt_status(receipt, files):
    pins = receipt.get('source_pins', {})
    missing = sorted(n for n in pins if n not in files)
    stale = sorted(n for n, h in pins.items() if n in files and sha(files[n]) != h)
    return {'result': receipt.get('result', 'absent'), 'stale_source_pins': stale, 'missing_source_pins': missing, 'pins_present': bool(pins), 'current': bool(pins) and not stale and not missing}

files, inventory_issues = inventory()
pins = {n: sha(data) for n, data in sorted(files.items())}
findings = scan(files)
observations = []
def record(case, actual, expected, relation=None):
    result = 'pass' if actual == expected else 'fail'
    observations.append({'case': case, 'relation': relation, 'observed': actual, 'expected': expected, 'result': result})
    return result == 'pass'

# In-memory hostile controls never place credentials or private infrastructure in checkout.
record('planted synthetic credential is rejected', bool(scan({'ignored.env': ('api_key="' + 'synthetic_audit_fixture_123456' + '"').encode()})), True)
record('planted private address is flagged', bool(scan({'private.txt': b'host=10.42.7.9'})), True)
record('benign public project URL passes narrow detector', scan({'url.txt': b'https://github.com/Clear-Sights/Makoto'}), [])
record('changed selected bytes invalidate a receipt', receipt_status({'result': 'pass', 'source_pins': {'x': sha(b'before')}}, {'x': b'after'})['current'], False)
record('missing selected file invalidates a receipt', receipt_status({'result': 'pass', 'source_pins': {'x': sha(b'before')}}, {})['current'], False)
record('unpinned receipt is not current', receipt_status({'result': 'pass'}, files)['current'], False)

tracked_check = command(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'])
ignored_check = command(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--ignored', '--exclude-standard', '-z'])
tracked = set(tracked_check['stdout'].split('\0')) - {''}
ignored = set(ignored_check['stdout'].split('\0')) - {''}
manifest = [{'path': n, 'sha256': pins[n], 'bytes': len(data), 'classification': 'tracked' if n in tracked else 'ignored' if n in ignored else 'untracked'} for n, data in sorted(files.items())]
record('enumerate current files regardless of Git tracking or ignore status', {'files': len(files), 'tracked': sum(m['classification']=='tracked' for m in manifest), 'ignored': sum(m['classification']=='ignored' for m in manifest)}, {'files': len(files), 'tracked': len(tracked & files.keys()), 'ignored': len(ignored & files.keys())}, 'all_current:pinned_audited')
record('Git history excluded from audit inputs', any(n == '.git' or n.startswith('.git/') for n in files), False, 'history:excluded')
record('current narrow credential scan', [f for f in findings if f['category'] != 'private_address_requires_review'], [], 'secret:rejected')
record('current private-address scan', [f for f in findings if f['category'] == 'private_address_requires_review'], [], 'private_infra:rejected')

groups = {}
for n, h in pins.items():
    groups.setdefault(h, []).append(n)
duplicates = [names for names in groups.values() if len(names) > 1]
observations.append({'case': 'exact byte duplicate review', 'groups': duplicates, 'result': 'absent', 'detail': 'Exact matches alone do not establish unnecessary duplication; semantic near-duplicates require review.'})
stale_content = []
for name, phrase, reason in [
    ('HANDOFF.md', 'manifest 4.0.1 disagrees with README 4.0.0', 'Current README and manifest are both 4.0.1.'),
    ('HANDOFF.md', 'No current checks/plants were executed', 'Retained current receipts record checks; this sentence, if present, is historical.'),
    ('LACKS.md', 'All nine MESH citations', 'Current mesh contains a different task graph and bare citations.'),
    ('LACKS.md', 'No current checks/plants were executed', 'Current receipts record executed checks; document does not describe the current model.'),
]:
    if phrase in files.get(name, b'').decode(errors='replace'):
        stale_content.append({'path': name, 'claim': phrase, 'assessment': reason})
observations.append({'case': 'stale current documentation review', 'findings': stale_content, 'result': 'fail' if stale_content else 'absent'})
observations.append({'case': 'dead and semantic duplicate content review', 'result': 'absent', 'detail': 'Reference code is intentionally retained per mesh/README.md. No complete semantic liveness or redundancy proof is available; absence of exact duplicates does not prove this facet.'})
receipts = {n: receipt_status(json.loads(data), files) for n, data in sorted(files.items()) if n.startswith('mesh/evidence/') and n.endswith('.json')}
observations.append({'case': 'current upstream receipt audit', 'receipts': receipts, 'result': 'fail' if any(not r['current'] or r['result'] != 'pass' for r in receipts.values()) else 'pass'})

with (ROOT/'TASKS.tsv').open(newline='') as f:
    tasks = list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t'))
finished = set()
todo = {t['task']: t for t in tasks}
waves = []
while todo:
    ready = sorted(n for n, t in todo.items() if set(filter(None, t['deps'].split(','))) <= finished)
    if not ready:
        raise RuntimeError('dependency cycle or missing task')
    waves.append({'wave': len(waves)+1, 'tasks': ready, 'predicted_tokens': sum(int(todo[n]['estimate_tokens']) for n in ready)})
    finished.update(ready)
    for n in ready:
        del todo[n]
record('fresh dependency waves match current plan', all(f"Wave {w['wave']}: {', '.join(w['tasks'])} (predicted {w['predicted_tokens']} tokens)" in files['PLAN.md'].decode() for w in waves), True)
check = command(['python3', 'mesh/check.py', '--task', 'audit'])
record('specified declarative model checker', check['exit_code'], 0)

output = {
    'task': 'audit', 'requirement': 'audit', 'candidate_status': 'OPEN',
    'selected_input_digest': sha(canonical(pins)), 'source_pins': pins,
    'digest_method': 'SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical source_pins JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False)',
    'scope': 'Every accessible current file including hidden, untracked and ignored content. Root .git/history excluded. Audit output excluded from self-pins to avoid recursive hashing. Narrow local scanners and explicit documentation review are bounded observations, not a complete semantic content certificate.',
    'inventory': manifest, 'inventory_issues': inventory_issues, 'observations': observations,
    'checks': [check], 'rederived_waves': waves,
    'present': ['current_content_inventory_pinned', 'history:excluded', 'local_credential_and_private_address_controls', 'stale_and_missing_receipts_rejected', 'current_waves_rederived', 'declarative_audit_check_passed'],
    'absent': ['all_current:pinned_audited:complete_semantic_certificate', 'private_infra:complete_review', 'dead:rejected', 'duplicate:rejected', 'worktree:clean', 'all_upstream_receipts_current_and_passing', 'audit:bound_proof_producer'],
    'external': ['Clean committed worktree requires writable Git metadata; supplied .git is read-only.', 'Authentic operator, register approval and exact-head CI evidence remain unavailable.'],
    'failure_policy': 'Re-measure changed input and re-derive waves; unavailable operator or outside evidence = EXTERNAL. Local stale content and stale receipts are failures requiring repair, not external evidence.',
    'result': 'fail',
    'reproduction': {'command': 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 /tmp/makoto-audit.py', 'script': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
# Write the artifact before measuring worktree status, so the observation includes it.
(ROOT/OUTPUT).write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
status = command(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'])
output['worktree'] = status
record('actual worktree is clean', status['exit_code'] == 0 and not status['stdout'].strip(), True, 'worktree:clean')
current_files, current_issues = inventory()
record('audit input bytes and coverage unchanged during measurement', {n: sha(data) for n, data in sorted(current_files.items())}, pins)
output['observations'] = observations
# Final output gets the same bounded detectors; matching values are not emitted.
serialized = json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
output['output_scan'] = {'findings': scan({OUTPUT: serialized.encode()}), 'self_pin_exclusion': 'This generated output is an audit artifact; its embedded synthetic scanner fixtures are documented controls, not operational credentials or infrastructure.'}
(ROOT/OUTPUT).write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'files_pinned': len(files), 'scan_findings': len(findings), 'stale_documentation_findings': len(stale_content), 'stale_receipts': sum(not r['current'] for r in receipts.values()), 'worktree_clean': not bool(status['stdout'].strip()), 'model_check_exit': check['exit_code'], 'result': output['result']}))
